footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to LB Pharmaceuticals: includes $25.2M from preferred dividends. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: The company had no revenue in 2025. The operating loss narrowed to $29.1M from $64.8M.
The net loss narrowed to $25K, or −$3.13 per share, from $63K. Operating cash flow was −$35.2M and free cash flow −$35.3M, versus −$53.8M.
sources: LB Pharmaceuticals Inc Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with a limited operating history and no history of commercializing products…
We have incurred substantial losses since our inception
We will require substantial additional financing to achieve our goals, and failure to obtain additional capital when needed…
The obligations from our royalty agreements may be a drain on our cash resources…
Preclinical and clinical development involves a lengthy and expensive process, with an uncertain outcome, and results of earlier studies…
Even if our product candidate receives regulatory approval, it may fail to achieve the degree of market acceptance by physicians, patients…
strategy: Achieve regulatory approval for LB-102 for the treatment of schizophrenia
Advance LB-102 as a potential multidimensional treatment for patients with schizophrenia
Expand development of LB-102 into bipolar depression, adjunctive MDD and other neuropsychiatric disorders
Extend the life-cycle and global reach of LB-102 by advancing alternate formulations
Maximize the commercial opportunity of LB-102
